entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
2.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Raghunathpali P.S. Case No.56 of 2024 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No.15 of 2024 for the offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n) of I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional District Judge-cum- PO Special Court (POCSO), Sundargarh.
He is aggrieved by the order dated 26.02.2024 passed by the learned Court below, whereby his bail application has been rejected.
Subsequent, thereto on 28.03.2024, the police have filed the charge-sheet in the present case.

3. I am not inclined to entertain this petition at this stage owing to the fact that during investigation,
the bail plea was made by the petitioner and subsequently, since charge-sheet has been filed, the petitioner should approach the Court of first instance.
4. With this observation, the BLAPL is disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Swarna Designation: Senior Stenographer
